title: AAPS not sending basal to xDrip
symptom: Since updating to AAPS version 2.7, xDrip does not receive basal data. It receives carbs and bolus (via Nightscout) but not basals. Some users report xDrip not receiving any treatments when there is no internet connection, and basal display in xDrip has not worked for years.
cause: AAPS never sent basals to xDrip; xDrip was parsing them from watch data, which was about to fail. Additionally, nsclient may stop broadcasting locally when there is no internet connection.
fix: Enable the xDrip Statusline plugin from the config builder to see basal rate in the status line, but this does not fix the basal plot in xDrip. No definitive fix is provided in the thread.
evidence_quote: AAPS never sent basals to xDrip. xDrip was parsing those from the watch data. That was about to fail.
